hero.title: Rollercoaster.dev
hero.subtitle: Open Badges tools by and for neurodivergent minds. Built to support flexible learning and growth.

whatWeBuild.title: What We're Building
whatWeBuild.subtitle: Open Badges Platform for Neurodivergent Creators
whatWeBuild.description: We're building a complete Open Badges platform that celebrates diverse achievements and learning paths. Open Badges are digital credentials you own and control. They're portable, verifiable proof of your skills and accomplishments. Our platform recognizes that success isn't one-size-fits-all.

trackProgress.title: Track and Showcase Progress
trackProgress.description: Track progress on any goal that matters to you – learning, work, hobbies, community action, personal growth, and more. Our flexible system adapts to your unique journey. You can document and celebrate achievements in a way that makes sense for you.
trackProgress.item1: Track any goal that matters to you

visualizeJourney.title: Visualize Your Journey
visualizeJourney.description: See your progress and achievements in visual formats that work for you. Our platform offers different views of your journey. This helps you recognize patterns, celebrate milestones, and stay motivated.

pauseRestart.title: Pause and Restart with Ease
pauseRestart.description: Life isn't linear, and neither is progress. Our system supports natural ebbs and flows. You can pause during challenging times like burnout or low motivation. When you're ready to return, your progress is preserved and tools help you pick up where you left off.
pauseRestart.item2: Your work stays safe while you rest
pauseRestart.item3: Pick up exactly where you left off

connectCommunity.title: Connect with Community
connectCommunity.description: Join a community that understands. Share experiences, learn from others' journeys, and find mutual support. Our platform helps you connect with others through shared achievements and collaborative learning.

buildCommunity.title: Build Community
buildCommunity.description: Connect with other neurodivergent creators, share your journey, and discover new opportunities. Our platform helps you build genuine connections and grow together.

shareJourney.title: Share Your Journey
shareJourney.description: Tell your story in a way that works for you. Our platform supports various formats and styles. You can document and share your progress authentically.

vision.title: Our Vision: Tools Built From Lived Experience
vision.description: Most productivity tools assume linear thinking and fixed schedules. That doesn't work for many neurodivergent minds.

challenge.title: The Challenge
challenge.content: Rigid schedules and linear lists don't align with how our minds work best. We understand that neurodivergent strengths are different. Navigating goals requires tools that offer flexibility, clear steps, and genuine understanding – not just another calendar.

solution.title: Our Solution
solution.content: At Rollercoaster.dev, our vision is simple: Create the tools we wish existed, built by and for the neurodivergent community.

empower.title: 🎯 To Empower Users
empower.description: Breaking down overwhelming goals into manageable, actionable steps that make sense for you.

flexibility.title: 🌊 To Offer Flexibility
flexibility.description: Adapting to your fluctuating energy and focus, free from rigid timelines and expectations.

community.title: 🤝 To Foster Community
community.description: Building connections through shared understanding and mutual support, because we truly 'get it'.

vision.closing: We're building this because we understand the need firsthand. We're creating solutions that embrace and support the diverse ways neurodivergent minds thrive.

coreEngine.title: Core Badge Engine
coreEngine.description: The foundational server that processes and validates Open Badges, handles credential verification, and manages the core badge ecosystem.

userInterface.title: User Interface (Vue)
userInterface.description: Accessible Vue.js components and interfaces that make badge management clear and straightforward for neurodivergent users.

communityFeatures.title: Open Badges System
communityFeatures.description: The complete open badges platform where server and UI work together to create the first fully open-source Rollercoaster.dev system.

getInvolved.title: Join Our Journey
getInvolved.description: Rollercoaster.dev is being built by neurodivergent people, for neurodivergent people. We believe in the power of lived experience to create tools that truly work.
